newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sugar to tender for 30,000T U.S. soy/corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sugar to tender for 30,000T U.S. soy/corn.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on Thursday for 20,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn and 10,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow soybeans, traders said on Tuesday.
A Taiwan Sugar buyer, who confirmed the tender plan, said the Iraq crisis already was driving international grain prices higher and that Thursday's tender was the soonest Taiwan Sugar could arrange.
The maximun moisture limits for the shipment are specified at 14.5 percent for the corn and 13.5 percent for the soybeans.
